current_training_imagery.source: NAIP via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC; exact IDs reconstructed from retained AOI bbox and latest-year fetcher rule
current_training_imagery.identity_limit: Current 2021 source item IDs are reconstructed from the retained AOI bbox/latest-year rule. Local raster metadata says band 4 color interpretation alpha while the source is expected to be RGBN; exact STAC raster:bands and training loader semantics must be reconciled before use.
current_training_imagery.band_integrity_issue: Rasterio reports colorinterp red/green/blue/alpha and nodata=0 for the local NAIP raster, while the trained input pipeline is described as RGBN. Fourth band has continuous non-binary values in inspected pixels. Resolve from exact STAC item asset metadata and inspect loader/channel normalization before treating it as alpha or NIR.

preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.source: Park City / Summit County PC2018Imagery ArcGIS ImageServer
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.coverage_screen: All 24 recovered Park City audit-window centerpoints transformed from EPSG:32612 fall inside the published image-service extent. This is metadata-extent overlap, not verified valid-pixel coverage.
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.relative_resolution: 0.5 m pixels are finer than the current 0.6 m NAIP grid; resampling and registration must be measured before pairing.
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.why_test_it: The June/July flight is a stronger candidate for testing snow visibility because it is earlier in the snow-free season than the mixed September/November current mosaic. It also offers a different illumination opportunity, but the service metadata reviewed here does not give local flight time or sun geometry. Flight dates alone do not prove snow-free ground, clearer tread, or low shadow.
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.pixel_comparison_status: bounded retrieval complete for 24 exact Park City windows from the completed A replay audit manifest; imagery-only paired sheets produced
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.permission_status: unknown: public endpoint access does not establish ML reuse rights
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.trail_change_risk: 2018 imagery predates the 2021 training mosaic; trails built, closed, or rerouted between dates must be excluded from reference scoring.
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.valid_pixel_result: 13/24 candidate windows have entirely zero RGB; mean candidate RGB zero-filled fraction is 0.571854. The returned raster mask reports 100% valid and therefore does not detect these zero responses.
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.band_order_and_masks: not verified; image responses are four-band, but service band names are absent from reviewed service metadata. Treat fourth-band role and masks as unknown; do not treat numeric zero alone as nodata.
preferred_followup_imagery_candidate.review_status: blinded human scoring pending; snow/shadow/cloud/canopy/tread visibility and local registration not scored

independent_local_reference_candidates.name: Mountain Trails Foundation Park City trail guide/map
independent_local_reference_candidates.reason: Park City identifies this as its most accurate online local-trail resource, but a dated downloadable GIS/as-built/maintenance layer, lineage, positional uncertainty, historic fit, and ML permission remain unverified. Use as contextual evidence only until those are resolved.

independent_local_reference_candidates.name: Park City Municipal WalkingRoutes ArcGIS FeatureServer layer
independent_local_reference_candidates.known_gaps: The published extent is east of the retained Park City training AOI extent after transforming to WKID 3566. The service exposes no acquisition/lineage date in the reviewed metadata, and this appears to be a walking-route layer rather than a verified MTB singletrack reference. Recheck geographic overlap and layer semantics before using it.

recommended_experiment.design: Use the 24 canonical A replay Park City windows (manifest hash recorded above). First validate source IDs, band order, per-pixel valid masks and alignment; exclude invalid response areas. Give imagery-only sheets to a blinded reviewer, without sample key, labels or predictions, and separately record snow, bright bare, deep shadow, canopy, cloud, and tread visibility. Only then compare clear valid corridors against dated independent trail references and assess 2018 trail-change risk.
recommended_experiment.registration: Retrieval used matching 127.8 m footprints and the same canonical centerpoints; this is not proof of pixel registration. Estimate offsets on stable landmarks using only valid pixels. Do not compare pixels or use older imagery to score labels until registration and trail-date compatibility are established.
recommended_experiment.decision_rule: Do not replace or augment training imagery from this screen. Candidate requires valid coverage, verified RGBN/band semantics, source masks consistent with pixels, within-one-current-pixel registration, blinded corridor-level visibility improvement, no material tread change and documented reuse rights. Preserve snowy/shadowed/canopied cases as separate unsupported/unknown evaluation slices until independent tread truth exists.

next_sites.data_quality_limit: NAIP dates and TNM 3DEP metadata extents are discovery evidence; actual valid pixels, weather/season appearance, independent target/distractor sample counts, and site-specific permissions remain unknown.
